# LLM-CSEC: security of C/C++ generated by LLMs

**Date:** 2025-11 (arXiv 2511.18966)  
**URL:** <https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18966>  
**Raw:** `raw/papers/llm-csec-2025.md`

## What it claims

Shahid, Ahmed and Ranjan ran ten LLMs, scanned the C/C++ they produced with static analysis (SAST), sorted the findings by CWE, and mapped them to CVEs to judge how serious they were. The authors call the number of CWEs "concerning" and point out that generated code lacks defensive programming constructs.

## What it adds

An independent replication of [[sun-2024-formai-v2]] that uses SAST instead of a model checker. The two methods lead to the same conclusion.
